workload: Same1024 natural-generation math requests in source order; all at zero. No answer keys in runtime.
metrics: All original1024 arrivals: completion, TTFT, request max host token gap, output throughput, SLO-only and correct+SLO goodput under preexisting diagnostic20s/4s; correctness/EOS/caps/repeats, preemption cycles/recompute, per-request wins/losses. No quality filtering.
resource_recovery: Resource wait releases shared GPU lock every15s. Recheck after model hashes. Per-unit1200s total deadline; native GPU child launched at most once. Post-child SHA-verified lossless xz compression of only three large own raw logs. Decompress with receipt SHA verification before local analysis.
rationale: Test whether constant physical margin covers the dynamic next-step resident signal at the strongest measured native configuration.
hypothesis: Dynamic state must improve complete-request outcomes beyond the best constant margin, including its actual overhead; fewer preemptions alone does not establish value.
scope: Development only. Fixed same candidate full-known-sequence+1 query, substituted resident-next requirement with a constant32/48/64 physical blocks. All requests, outputs, timing and quality retained.
decision_rule: Compare mean full-request completion, tail and quality vs native4096 and unchanged runway4096; report all1024 and identical-output sensitivity. Static covers dynamic => scoped no-go for dynamic signal necessity on this workload. A single winning run only warrants replication.
